decision_question: Can the frozen complement screen trust serialized residuals, or must the scorer reproduce the pair, feature arithmetic, tick state, and executable asks before using them?

defect.before: The schema-4 scorer consumed stored complement midpoint and microprice residuals directly. It did not deserialize the raw paired bids, asks, depths, token IDs, or stored microprices that produced those residuals.
defect.risk: A token-wiring, serialization, arithmetic, or quote-alignment defect could manufacture apparent coherence and fee-aware economics while every statistical gate still passed.

research_interpretation.venue_mechanism: The CLOB can match complementary outcome orders through complete-set mint and merge settlement, so paired-book coherence is partly constrained by market mechanics.
research_interpretation.strategy_implication: The feature remains a prospective uncertainty veto, not independent directional alpha or free arbitrage. Its value must still be demonstrated on two sealed forward blocks and exact executable replay.

token_identity: chosen and opposite token IDs must be non-empty and distinct
the unordered token pair must remain stable within a condition
the chosen token for a given condition and direction must remain stable
reproduction_contract.book_validity: Both serialized books must have finite prices strictly inside zero and one, bid below ask, positive bid and ask depth, and stored microprice inside the spread.
reproduction_contract.economic_alignment: The chosen and opposite serialized best asks must equal the corresponding recorded decision-time up/down executable asks used by the normalized one-dollar economic screen.
reproduction_contract.dynamic_tick_alignment: Any serialized top price outside the inclusive 0.04 to 0.96 interval requires market_tick_size no greater than 0.001.
reproduction_contract.missing_pair_action: reject the row through the existing feature-coverage path
reproduction_contract.inconsistent_serialized_pair_action: abort scoring with an input-integrity error

implementation.schema_version_unchanged_reason: The output fields, fixed rule, gates, and interpretation are unchanged; only scorer-side input verification is stricter.

deployed_scorer_v6.scoring_requirement: Use this v6 binary or a later binary whose strategy_builder.rs hash matches this amendment.

validation.cargo_test: PASS: 501 passed (450 library + 51 binary), 0 failed; doc-tests 0

external_sources.title: Polymarket Prices and Orderbook
external_sources.use: Complementary Yes and No buy orders can match when their prices sum to one, and the buyer pays the executable ask rather than the displayed midpoint.

external_sources.title: Polymarket CTF Exchange V2
external_sources.use: The exchange distinguishes complementary transfer, mint, and merge settlement paths, confirming that raw pair identity and quote alignment are market-structure invariants.

decision.next_step: Continue the sealed first block to 750 unique officially aligned terminal conditions, then score exactly once with measurement-v7 or a later binary retaining this reproduction-hardened scorer hash.
